decisions.reason: It remains a close fit with the core finishing portfolio and automation story, and after surviving the first post-launch year in a growing market it is still more likely to be retained than withdrawn.

Even though it is more distant from the traditional range, it was highlighted as a flagship Germany premiere and supports the firm's move into higher-value digital finishing, so we would keep it while accepting somewhat higher portfolio risk.

As a sheet preparation module that directly strengthens integrated postpress workflows, it fits the firm's established business and software-connected direction very well and looks unlikely to be removed soon.
